item.title: Omega no Shikai -1. Shiki no Hajimari-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nekobanana
  • 発売日: 2006-12-31
  • スコア: 6.76/10 (30 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Omegaの視界 1.シキのはじまり
  • 英語名: Omega no Shikai -1. Shiki no Hajimari-

别名

  • Omega no Shikai -1. Shiki no Hajimari-

あらすじ

A mystical visual novel for a cat, set against the backdrop of incidents in the library town.

Blessed be the eyes of Omega.

Alongside the self-proclaimed beautiful bookseller, Miyaoka Kadomi, the protagonist, Iikubo Makoto, set out to the rural “Mysterious Forest” up north.
